1477-2173-4574--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
1477-2173-4574--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

645-1267-3899-3908.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

4247-6972-7158.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

394-586-864-3125-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-3125-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2738-4556-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Blight Mound, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

824-2438-2728-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2438-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2438-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Atog ability.

5016-6339-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Spitemare indestructible using Rootborn Defenses.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5016-6339-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

539-2781-7038.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Toph.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Felidar Guardian as it's a land due to Ashaya.
Since zero mana was spent to cast Toph, Felidar Guardian becomes a 0/0 creature and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Toph triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.

Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.

Repeat from step 2.

2060-2438-3054-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Case of the Shattered Pact trigger, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Faceless One from the battlefield to your hand.

When the Fractal enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Fractal.
Kill the Fractal.
The Fractal triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its power.

77-277-1227-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ordeal of Nylea, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.

When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers twice, untapping them.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability from step 2, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

Repeat.
